LESSON: SOKONI

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.26: Sokoni

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sokoni. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati unaohusiana na shughuli za sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati wa sokoni ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kufahamu maana ya msamiati unaotumiwa sokoni ili kuwezesha mawasiliano
4. kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno na sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili shughuli za sokoni. kuimarisha stadi ya kuandika f) kuthamini shughuli za sokoni. Kusikiliza na kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2)
5. kutaja watu wanaopatikana sokoni katika kuendeleza mazungumzo
6. kusikiliza maelezo kuhusu sokoni ili kujenga usikivu 114

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati unaohusiana na shughuli za sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati unaohusiana na shughuli za sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma msamiati wa sokoni ili kujenga usomaji bora
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma msamiati wa sokoni ili kujenga usomaji bora. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kufahamu maana ya msamiati unaotumiwa sokoni ili kuwezesha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kufahamu maana ya msamiati unaotumiwa sokoni ili kuwezesha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno na sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili shughuli za sokoni. kuimarisha stadi ya kuandika f) kuthamini shughuli za sokoni. Kusikiliza na kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno na sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili shughuli za sokoni. kuimarisha stadi ya kuandika f) kuthamini shughuli za sokoni. Kusikiliza na kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

5. kutaja watu wanaopatikana sokoni katika kuendeleza mazungumzo
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutaja watu wanaopatikana sokoni katika kuendeleza mazungumzo. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

6. kusikiliza maelezo kuhusu sokoni ili kujenga usikivu 114
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusikiliza maelezo kuhusu sokoni ili kujenga usikivu 114. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Sokoni.
2. Explain Sokoni to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sokoni.
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati unaohusiana na shughuli za sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Sokoni. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Sokoni important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati unaohusiana na shughuli za sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati wa sokoni ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kufahamu maana ya msamiati unaotumiwa sokoni ili kuwezesha mawasiliano
4. kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno na sentensi akitumia msamiati wa sokoni ili shughuli za sokoni. kuimarisha stadi ya kuandika f) kuthamini shughuli za sokoni. Kusikiliza na kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2)

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
